richiami.difetto: The rear fixing bolts of the FASP swivel seat can under extreme circumstances fail.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts replaced with those of a higher specification.
richiami.titolo: SEAT FIXING REAR BOLTS MAY FAIL
